from griffe.loader import GriffeLoader

# Create a loader with the source directory as a search path
loader = GriffeLoader(search_paths=["./src"])

# Load the package
package = loader.load("mypkg")

# Resolve all aliases (imported and re-exported names)
loader.resolve_aliases()

print(f"Successfully loaded: {package.name}")
